_comment: Frozen cross-implementation golden vectors for the Warren multihop control wire (/v2). Every language SDK must reproduce these bytes. Framing: CONTROL_FIRST_BYTE 0xC0, CONTROL_VERSION 0x02, then postcard(WarrenControlMessage). The retired /v1 (version byte 0x01) is rejected. Any change is a wire break and requires a new version byte. The `name` field selects which message a replay test reconstructs.

vectors.name: ip_request_minimal
vectors._comment: IpRequest with every option absent: variant tag 0, then four None/false bytes.

vectors.name: ip_request_full
vectors._comment: IpRequest: prefer_ipv4 Some(10.66.0.42), client_pubkey Some(0x42*32), wants_ipv6 true, pop_sig Some(0xa5*64 raw, no length prefix).

vectors.name: ip_assign
vectors._comment: IpAssign: ipv4 10.66.0.7, prefix_len 24, gateway 10.66.0.1, no IPv6.
